marketContext: Sheffield is a large post-industrial city undergoing sustained regeneration. It has a strong independent business culture, two major universities, and a growing tech and creative sector alongside traditional trades and professional services. Digital service demand is strong, with high competition in the city centre and commercial suburbs and moderate to low competition in community areas.
